problem_statement: CloudCannon/sendit-astro-template ('Sendit', an email-campaign marketing SaaS) is a runnable Astro 5 marketing site whose pages are frontmatter content blocks (src/content/pages/*.md) rendered through src/shared/astro/page.astro, with reusable global components, a shared Heading/Button system and a red-accent / rounded-card / dark-panel visual language across the home, features, pricing, signup, contact, about and blog routes. The template ships its own three-tier pricing feature (Free / Pro / Business plan cards) but with a single fixed price per plan and no way to switch billing period. Enhance the site's OWN pricing feature with a Monthly / Annual billing control and integrate it consistently across the site while preserving the Sendit visual system: (1) ADD a billing switch to the pricing section - a 'global/billing-plans' content block whose '.billing-toggle' has a 'Billing' label, a Monthly/Annual pill toggle and a '.billing-readout' line - and give each '.plan-card' a monthly and an annual price (data-monthly / data-annual on the '.plan-price' node). Make the plan grid and the billing bar stay within the viewport on a 390px phone and a 768px tablet with no horizontal document overflow; do not merely clip them with overflow-x:hidden - the document itself must not exceed the viewport width. (2) Render the SAME billing-plans section consistently on the home page, the Features page AND the Pricing page (section modifiers billing-plans--home / --features / --pricing) so the billing control is a site-wide fixture, not a home-only afterthought. (3) Keep the plan grid in the Sendit palette (soft white rounded cards, red accent, the highlighted 'Most popular' Pro card) and make it visually faithful to the reference in the Annual state - the plan cards must not overlap, clip or wash out into illegible text when a period is selected. (4) Wire the billing toggle end to end: clicking 'Annual' must swap every plan card's price to its annual figure (e.g. Pro '$199/mo' -> '$1990/yr'), update the plan note to 'billed annually / 2 months free', and set the '.billing-readout' to 'Billing: Annual / 2 months free' (and back on 'Monthly'); the post-click terminal state must reflect the selected period, not stay frozen on Monthly. Keep the navigation, hero, feature sections, testimonials, FAQ accordion, mobile navigation toggle, footer, routes and local image assets intact, and keep the browser console clean.
required_content: The pricing feature gains a 'global/billing-plans' section whose '.billing-toggle' has a 'Billing' label, a Monthly/Annual pill toggle and a '.billing-readout' line, and each '.plan-card' carries a monthly and an annual price (data-monthly / data-annual on '.plan-price'); the plan grid + billing bar stay within a 390px phone and a 768px tablet with no horizontal document overflow beyond 24px.

The same billing-plans section is rendered on the home page, the Features page AND the Pricing page (billing-plans--home / --features / --pricing) - one shared control in all three places, not only on the home page.

The plan grid keeps the Sendit look (soft white rounded cards, red accent, the highlighted 'Most popular' Pro card) and is visually faithful to the reference in the Annual state - the cards do not overlap, clip or wash out into illegible text.

The billing toggle is wired end to end: clicking Annual swaps every plan price to its annual figure (Pro '$199/mo' -> '$1990/yr'), updates the note to 'billed annually / 2 months free' and sets the '.billing-readout' to 'Billing: Annual / 2 months free'; the post-click terminal state reflects the selected period, not the default Monthly.
The desktop (1440px) and tablet (768px) layouts stay within their viewports and the plan cards stack/wrap cleanly on 390px mobile.

The navigation, hero, feature sections, testimonials, FAQ accordion, mobile navigation toggle, footer, routes and local image assets remain reachable and unchanged, and the site keeps a clean browser console.
design_constraints: Build the plan grid and the '.billing-toggle' bar so they wrap/shrink within a 390px phone and 768px tablet; do not force a fixed-width nowrap row or fake the fix with overflow-x:hidden.
Render the SAME billing-plans section on the home, Features AND Pricing pages so it is consistent site-wide; do not add it to only one page.

Preserve the Sendit visual language: red primary accent, soft white rounded plan cards, the highlighted popular card, shared Heading/Button components and the content-block rendering architecture; the Annual state must render the plan cards cleanly, not overlapping/clipped/illegible.
Wire the billing toggle end to end (the plan prices, the plan notes and the '.billing-readout' must all reflect the clicked period), not merely a class toggle.

Keep the Astro content-block architecture and all local image assets; do not add a dependency, edit package files, replace src/shared/astro/page.astro, remove routes, or introduce a new design system.
state_constraints: desktop_home, tablet_home and mobile_home verify the Sendit hero, navigation wordmark and, further down the page, the billing-plans pricing section render consistently across viewports with no horizontal overflow.

desktop_billing_annual and mobile_billing_annual click the Annual period and verify the plan grid stays clean (no overlap/clip/illegible cards) and the '.billing-readout' + prices update to the annual figures; desktop_billing_monthly_back toggles back to Monthly.

desktop_features_billing and mobile_features_billing verify the SAME billing-plans section is present on the Features page and desktop_pricing_billing and mobile_pricing_billing verify it on the Pricing page (site-wide consistency).
desktop_faq_open opens the pricing-page FAQ accordion to verify the disclosure behavior survives.
mobile_nav_open opens the mobile navigation to verify the original toggle behavior survives.

change_completion: The pricing feature gains a Monthly/Annual billing control (label, toggle, .billing-readout) and the plan grid + billing bar render within the viewport on mobile and tablet.
The same billing-plans section appears on the home, Features and Pricing pages.
Clicking Annual updates the plan prices and the .billing-readout to the annual period.
design_consistency: The billing control and plan grid preserve the Sendit palette, rounded plan-card chrome, red accent and shared Heading/Button components.
The Annual state renders the plan cards cleanly (no overlap, clip or illegible text) and is visually faithful to the reference on the desktop and mobile billing-annual states.
interaction_continuity: Clicking the Annual toggle updates the '.billing-readout' to 'Billing: Annual / 2 months free' and swaps the plan prices to the annual figures (post-click terminal state reflects the change, not the default Monthly).
regression: Navigation, hero, feature sections, testimonials, FAQ accordion, mobile navigation toggle, footer and local image assets remain reachable and unchanged.
The Astro site builds statically and serves with a clean browser console.
responsive: 390px and 768px home states have no horizontal overflow beyond 24px.
The plan cards and billing bar wrap or shrink cleanly instead of forcing a fixed-width row.

scoring_notes: A correct patch adds the shared Monthly/Annual billing control to the template's own pricing feature, keeps the plan grid + billing bar within 390px/768px viewports, renders the same billing-plans section on the home + Features + Pricing pages, keeps the Annual state rendering the plan cards cleanly in the Sendit palette, and wires the toggle so the prices, notes and '.billing-readout' reflect the clicked period. A patch that leaves the plan grid a fixed-width nowrap row (baseline) overflows on mobile/tablet; a 'smart-wrong' patch (bad) keeps the fixed-width nowrap grid + masks it with a decorative overflow-x:hidden (still overflows), renders the section on the home page only (fails cross-page consistency), collapses the Annual plan grid so the cards overlap/clip and the price and feature text wash out into an illegible near-white (fails visual fidelity), and snapshots the readout/prices into a stale closure so clicking Annual moves the active pill but leaves the '.billing-readout' and the prices frozen on Monthly (fails the interaction terminal-state check) while its text and console stay clean.
author_notes: Repo-grounded Astro marketing Edit/experience_continuity task hardened to L4 on the CloudCannon/sendit-astro-template Sendit site. The lever is the template's OWN three-tier pricing feature, promoted into a reusable 'global/billing-plans' content block and enhanced with a Monthly/Annual billing control (public/billing-plans/grid.css + public/billing-plans/billing.js). The reference (a) adds the .billing-toggle bar + data-monthly/data-annual plan prices and wraps the plan grid so it stays within 390px/768px, (b) renders the same billing-plans section on the home, Features and Pricing pages (billing-plans--home/--features/--pricing), (c) keeps the Annual state rendering the plan cards cleanly in the soft-white red-accent Sendit palette, and (d) wires the toggle so the prices, notes and .billing-readout reflect the clicked period (live DOM read). The bad 'smart-wrong' solution keeps a fixed 1120px nowrap plan grid + a decorative overflow-x:hidden on an inner element (still overflows the document -> D6 fail on mobile/tablet), renders the section on the home page ONLY (D2 cross-page fail on Features + Pricing), collapses the Annual plan grid so the cards overlap/clip and the price and feature text wash out to a near-white illegible tone (D3 visual_regression fail on the desktop/mobile billing-annual crops via pixelmatch, ssim and block_fidelity), and snapshots the readout + price labels into a stale closure so clicking Annual moves the active pill and triggers the broken layout but leaves the .billing-readout and the prices frozen on Monthly (click succeeds -> action_history clean, but the terminal readout is stale -> D4 interaction_assertions fail). It fails FOUR distinct gates while all text/completion/regression/console signals pass; the baseline shares the D6 overflow + home-only control but re-syncs the readout/prices live so it PASSES D4 (leg-orthogonal). INFRA identical across the three legs: the billing-plans.astro component and its Sendit-styled rounded plan cards, the billing-plans section with the .billing-toggle shell and data-monthly/data-annual attributes on the home page (index.md), and the served grid.css/billing.js links. sendit ships no global overflow-x clamp and no scroll-animation library, so the mobile/tablet plan-grid overflow is a real, measurable document-width signal without neutralization.
